device_id.description: Assigned by the server when a node is created in the builder. Also the certificate CN, MQTT client id and MQTT username.

key.description: Channel ids and output keys. Short, stable, used in topics.

level.description: Perceived brightness, 0 to 1. The device maps it to duty with the output's curve.

rgb.description: sRGB color at full brightness; level scales it.

src.description: Who caused a change: ui:<user>, sched:<id>, scene:<id>, ai:<job>, admin:<user>, device (local button).

seq.description: Per (device, output) ordering number from the server. Monotonic; the server uses max(last + 1, unix time in microseconds).

profile.description: Firmware image: chip prefix plus feature set, e.g. c3-lights, c6-lights, c6-full.

bridge.description: Which bridge agent speaks for a bridged device.

part.description: What a bridged output physically is, for icons and default names.
